name: Hazur Palace (Palace Utelia) Dining Hall
area: Village Utelia (4 km off Ahmedabad-Bhavnagar highway, 6 km from Lothal)
signature_dish: Heritage palace dining in an 18th-century Indo-Saracenic residence
why_it_matters: The only proper dining option within the Lothal catchment — an 18th-century Indo-Saracenic palace (formerly Utelia Palace) of the Vaghela Rajput rulers, 6 km from the Lothal Harappan site and 5 km from Lothal Burkhi railway station. The 32-seat dining hall serves Indian, regional Gujarati, Indian-Chinese, and Continental; folk-music performances run evenings.
insider_tip: Lothal itself has no food vendors or shops at the site — carry water and snacks if you're only doing a half-day Lothal trip from Ahmedabad. Hazur Palace is the only sit-down meal between Bagodara and the dig; call 24 hours ahead.
signature_address: Hazur Palace (Palace Utelia), Village Utelia, near Vataman Chokadi, 4 km off Ahmedabad-Bhavnagar Highway, Ahmedabad District 382230
